$comment: Providers with a genuine free tier, curated. Every `id` is a real id in the gateway's own provider manifest (GET /api/v1/provider-plugin-manifest, 222 providers), so `omni-agent provider add <id>` resolves the base URL and auth mechanics from the gateway rather than from anything hardcoded here. `signup` is where a person goes to get the credential; those URLs are checked by scripts/check-provider-links.mjs and must not be shipped dead. `gives` is what the provider itself advertises - it is their claim, not a measurement, and the UI says so.

models.label: Pollinations
models.gives: GPT, Llama and Claude-class models with no account at all
models.note: Nothing to sign up for. Add it and it works.

models.label: Cerebras
models.gives: 1M tokens/day free, and the fastest inference of anything on this list
models.note: Free tier needs no card. Best single addition for speed.

models.label: Groq
models.gives: A generous free tier on Llama, Qwen and GPT-OSS models
models.note: Very fast. Rate-limited per minute rather than per month.

models.label: OpenCode Zen
models.gives: DeepSeek and Nemotron with no token cap
models.note: Free forever. This is the pool the agent already uses by default.

models.label: Kilo Code
models.gives: An auto-router plus Tencent Hy3, free forever
models.note: Sign in with your account instead of pasting a key.

models.label: SiliconFlow
models.gives: DeepSeek V3.2 and R1 on a free tier

models.label: Cloudflare Workers AI
models.gives: 50+ models on 10,000 free neurons a day
models.note: Needs a Cloudflare account ID as well as a token.

models.label: NVIDIA NIM
models.gives: GLM and MiniMax at roughly 40 requests/minute free

models.label: OpenRouter
models.gives: Every model tagged :free, and a much higher rate limit if you ever top up
models.note: The widest single catalogue. Free models are rate-limited, not metered.

models.label: Google Gemini
models.gives: A free tier on Gemini Flash models
models.note: Google publishes no quota API, so usage will read as unavailable.

models.label: Chutes
models.gives: Open-weight models on a free allowance

$commentSignIn: Providers you do not pay extra for because you ALREADY pay for them. Signing in routes the agent through a subscription the user is holding anyway. These are OAuth in the gateway's manifest.
$commentSearch: Web search keys. These are NOT gateway providers - they are used by this product's own search tool, and are stored in the local encrypted credential store. Free tiers here remove the throttling that keyless search hits.

search.label: Brave Search
search.note: Independent index. The best free search key to add.

search.label: Tavily
search.note: Built for agents; returns cleaned content, not just links.

search.label: Serper
search.note: Google results. The free grant does not renew.

search.label: Firecrawl
search.note: Scraping, not search. Used as the last escalation for hard pages.
